# Success Gravity

> Independent reviews and comparisons of AI and business-growth software, written for small teams and solo operators who need to pick one tool and move on. Every review follows a published testing method and states pricing, limits, and who the tool is wrong for — not just what it does well.

Success Gravity is operated by David Choi. The site earns affiliate commissions on some outbound links; this never changes a verdict or a ranking, and the method page below explains how reviews are produced.

## How reviews are made

- [How We Review](https://successgravity.com/how-we-review/): the testing method and scoring. Read this first to judge how much weight the verdicts deserve.
- [Affiliate Disclosure](https://successgravity.com/affiliate-disclosure/): which links earn commission and how that is kept separate from verdicts.
- [About](https://successgravity.com/about/): who runs the site.
- [Contact](https://successgravity.com/contact/)

## Tool reviews

Each review covers what the tool is, key features, current pricing, pros and cons, and a quick verdict.

- [Semrush](https://successgravity.com/review/semrush/): SEO and competitive research suite
- [Ahrefs alternatives and SEO tooling — Surfer SEO](https://successgravity.com/review/surfer-seo/): on-page SEO content optimization
- [HubSpot](https://successgravity.com/review/hubspot/): CRM and marketing automation

- [Mailmodo](https://successgravity.com/review/mailmodo/): interactive AMP email marketing

- [Canva](https://successgravity.com/review/canva/): design and brand templates
- [Synthesia](https://successgravity.com/review/synthesia/): AI avatar video generation
- [Murf AI](https://successgravity.com/review/murf-ai/): AI voiceover and text-to-speech
- [OpusClip](https://successgravity.com/review/opusclip/): long-form video to short clips
- [Shopify](https://successgravity.com/review/shopify/): hosted ecommerce platform

- [WordPress.com](https://successgravity.com/review/wordpress-com/): hosted WordPress
